accepted_advice: A controlled two-utility diagnostic can use the same frozen income process, entry distribution, timing, targets and weights in both arms, without treating either result as adopted.
Do not rescale entrant wealth immediately just to normalize denominators; an empirical construction must address age, income concepts, zero/negative earnings and the joint distribution.
Current 18-24 childless-renter entry proxy remains experimental at model entry18.
Full economic fit tables and standard diagnostics, parameter bounds and income-grid sensitivity are required; loss alone cannot choose a utility architecture.
The old-age family-income versus pension denominator is a real mismatch to settle before final adoption.

corrections.claim: Entry rank coupling imposes perfect wealth-income rank correlation.
corrections.judgment: Incorrect. The adapter maps probability intervals of old total-income ranks into persistent-income ranks while retaining conditional wealth dispersion. The empirical joint distribution is not estimated, but this is not perfect rank correlation.

corrections.claim: Income timing cannot explain housing misses and tightening it must move ownership the wrong way.
corrections.judgment: Not established. Affordability weakly expands mechanically at fixed state/prices, but no controlled timing counterfactual isolates equilibrium prices, saving, fertility or aggregate ownership effects.

corrections.claim: The entrant denominator discrepancy is second order because young renters mostly receive labor income.
corrections.judgment: Unsupported quantitative claim; requires actual family-versus-labor-income decomposition in the selected sample.

corrections.claim: The asset-income wedge implies the observed sign of the old-age quantile-ratio gap.
corrections.judgment: Not established without recomputing the joint distribution and both quantiles; no monotone sign follows generally.

corrections.claim: Small theta0 implies nearly all bequests are accidental.
corrections.judgment: Unsupported without a measured decomposition or controlled no-motive comparison. Parameter magnitude alone is insufficient.

corrections.claim: A housing-floor bound hit makes this no longer a floor-versus-share comparison.
corrections.judgment: It remains a bounded specification comparison; it cannot establish the unrestricted relative fit of both model classes.

corrections.claim: Strip business and vehicles from empirical net worth.
corrections.judgment: Not adopted. A composite model asset can represent these holdings; reconcile asset coverage before removing components.

verified_timing.income_eligibility: Y/R augments eligible resources; not undiscounted Y added to transaction wealth.
verified_timing.transaction_wealth: x = b + sale proceeds - purchase cost; income is not also added to x.
verified_timing.budget: c + owner costs + b_next = R*x + Y, with applicable household spending definitions.
verified_timing.end_debt: b_next >= -phi*pH remains in force for owners.
verified_timing.interpretation: Permits current-period income to support purchase with temporary within-period financing. Correct accounting does not certify the economic timing assumption.

bequest_primary_reference_check.paper: De Nardi and Yang (2014), European Economic Review 72, 182-196
bequest_primary_reference_check.location: Table2, printed p187, PDF page6; adjacent calibration paragraph.
bequest_primary_reference_check.verified: The published article lists data bequest/wealth .0088 and attributes that moment to Gale and Scholz (1994). It targets wealth/after-tax earnings6.90, which is not comparable directly to project gross-earnings target6.14586. Its third moment is a decedent bequest-distribution statistic, not our living-old wealth/income ratio.
bequest_primary_reference_check.unverified: Original Gale-Scholz numerator/denominator coverage and modern empirical applicability, including inter-vivos or spousal transfer treatment, remain unverified here. Synthetic5% target scale remains a project choice.

next_decision: Author discussion of explicit diagnostic timing and preserved B entry law; exact-loop smoke and bounded reviewed design still required before any overnight launch.
